recipes.name: Oatmeal with pumpkin and cinnamon
recipes.description: Creamy milk oatmeal with pumpkin puree and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Bring the milk to a simmer, add the oats and cook for 5 minutes, stirring. Stir in the pumpkin puree and cinnamon and warm through for 2 minutes. Serve topped with chopped walnuts and honey.

recipes.name: Buckwheat porridge with milk and apple
recipes.description: Soft buckwheat cooked in milk with a grated apple.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the buckwheat, cover with 200 ml of water and cook for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed. Add the milk and cook for 5 more minutes. Stir in the grated apple and cinnamon, sweeten with honey.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese casserole with raisins
recipes.description: Baked cottage cheese with oats, eggs and raisins.
recipes.instructions: Mash the cottage cheese with the eggs, honey and half of the sour cream. Stir in the oats and raisins and leave for 10 minutes. Spread in a buttered dish, brush with the rest of the sour cream and bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and pepper in olive oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, paprika and cumin. Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes. Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with poached egg
recipes.description: Wholegrain toast with mashed avocado, egg and cherry tomatoes.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper and spread it on the toast. Poach the eggs for 3 minutes in simmering water and place on top with halved cherry tomatoes.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait with berries
recipes.description: Layers of yogurt, berries, toasted oats and almonds.
recipes.instructions: Toast the oats and chopped almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Layer the yogurt, berries and the oat mix in two glasses and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Chia pudding with mango
recipes.description: Overnight chia pudding on almond milk with fresh mango.
recipes.instructions: Stir the chia seeds into the almond milk with the maple syrup, wait 10 minutes and stir again. Refrigerate overnight. Serve topped with diced mango.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta omelette
recipes.description: A protein omelette with egg whites, spinach and feta.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the eggs, egg whites, milk and salt. Wilt the spinach in olive oil for 1 minute, pour in the eggs, scatter the crumbled feta and cook covered over low heat for 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana oat pancakes
recipes.description: Flourless pancakes from banana, eggs and oats with yogurt and blueberries.
recipes.instructions: Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder and cinnamon into a batter. Fry small pancakes on a lightly oiled pan, 2 minutes per side. Serve with yogurt and blueberries.

recipes.name: Tofu scramble with spinach and pepper
recipes.description: A vegan scramble with turmeric, pepper and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes. Crumble in the tofu, add turmeric and salt and fry for 5 minutes. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.

recipes.name: Quinoa breakfast bowl with berries
recipes.description: Quinoa cooked in almond milk with banana, raspberries and pumpkin seeds.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in the almond milk for 15 minutes until soft. Sweeten with maple syrup, top with sliced banana, raspberries and pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Rye toast with smoked salmon
recipes.description: Rye bread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and dill.
recipes.instructions: Spread the rye bread with cream cheese, top with sliced cucumber and smoked salmon and sprinkle with chopped dill.

recipes.name: Peanut butter overnight oats
recipes.description: Oats soaked in milk and yogurt with banana and peanut butter.
recipes.instructions: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds in two jars and refrigerate overnight. In the morning top with sliced banana and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Vegetable frittata
recipes.description: Oven-finished frittata with zucchini, pepper and cheddar.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, zucchini and pepper in olive oil for 6 minutes. Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables, scatter the cheddar and cook for 3 minutes. Finish in the oven at 190 °C for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with blueberries and flax
recipes.description: A quick high-protein breakfast bowl.
recipes.instructions: Put the cottage cheese in a bowl, top with blueberries and ground flaxseed and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Breakfast burrito with beans
recipes.description: Scrambled eggs, black beans, salsa and cheddar in a tortilla.
recipes.instructions: Scramble the eggs over medium heat. Warm the beans. Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans, salsa and cheddar, roll up and toast seam side down for 1 minute.

recipes.name: Rice porridge with butternut squash
recipes.description: Milk rice porridge with soft butternut squash.
recipes.instructions: Cook the diced squash in 200 ml of water for 10 minutes. Add the rice and milk and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring, until thick. Stir in the butter and honey.

recipes.name: Turkey and egg muffins
recipes.description: Egg muffins with ground turkey, spinach and pepper.
recipes.instructions: Brown the turkey with salt for 6 minutes. Whisk the eggs, stir in the turkey, chopped spinach and pepper. Pour into 9 muffin cups and bake at 180 °C for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish meatballs with couscous
recipes.description: Cod meatballs with dill, couscous and cherry tomatoes.
recipes.instructions: Mince the cod with the onion, mix in the egg, oats, dill and salt and shape small balls. Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes. Pour boiling water over the couscous with the olive oil, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Serve with halved cherry tomatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken quinoa salad
recipes.description: Grilled chicken, quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes and feta with lemon dressing.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes and cool. Season the chicken with salt and grill for 6 minutes per side, then slice. Toss the quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olive oil and lemon juice, top with the chicken and feta.

recipes.name: Beef and vegetable soup
recipes.description: A hearty soup with beef, potato and tomatoes.
recipes.instructions: Cover the beef with water, bring to a boil, skim and simmer for 70 minutes. Add the potato, carrot, onion and celery and cook for 20 minutes. Add the tomatoes and salt and cook for 10 more minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
recipes.description: Chicken broth with chicken breast, vegetables and noodles.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the chicken in the broth for 20 minutes, take it out and shred. Add the carrot, onion and celery and cook for 10 minutes. Add the pasta and cook for 7 minutes, return the chicken, salt and add dill.

recipes.name: Cabbage soup (shchi)
recipes.description: Fresh cabbage soup with potato and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and carrot in oil for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste. Boil the potato in the water for 10 minutes, add the shredded cabbage and the fried vegetables and cook for 20 minutes. Season with salt and dill, serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce with buckwheat
recipes.description: Soft turkey meatballs stewed in tomatoes, served with buckwheat.
recipes.instructions: Mix the turkey with the grated onion, egg and salt and shape meatballs. Brown them in oil, add the tomatoes and stew covered for 20 minutes. Cook the buckwheat in 450 ml of water for 15 minutes. Serve with dill.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach curry with rice
recipes.description: Coconut chickpea curry with tomatoes and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in oil for 5 minutes, add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta salad
recipes.description: Pasta with tuna, vegetables and olives in a lemon dressing.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta, rinse with cold water and drain. Mix with the drained tuna, tomatoes, cucumber, olives and red onion. Dress with olive oil, lemon juice and salt.

recipes.name: Lentil and vegetable stew
recipes.description: Green lentils stewed with carrot, celery and tomatoes.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 7 minutes, add the cumin. Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft. Season with salt.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl
recipes.description: Brown rice with chicken, black beans, corn, salsa and avocado.
recipes.instructions: Cook the brown rice. Season the chicken with cumin and fry in oil for 6 minutes per side, then slice. Warm the beans and corn. Arrange rice, chicken, beans, corn, salsa and sliced avocado in bowls and squeeze over the lime juice.

recipes.name: Mushroom soup with potato
recipes.description: Creamy mushroom soup thickened with potato, no cream.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and mushrooms in butter for 10 minutes. Add the potato and water and cook for 15 minutes. Add the milk and salt, blend until smooth and sprinkle with dill.

recipes.name: Greek salad with chicken
recipes.description: Romaine, vegetables, olives and feta with grilled chicken.
recipes.instructions: Grill the chicken for 6 minutes per side and slice. Chop the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, pepper and red onion. Toss with olives, olive oil, lemon juice and oregano, top with feta and chicken.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with bulgur and green beans
recipes.description: Roasted pork tenderloin with bulgur and garlicky green beans.
recipes.instructions: Rub the pork with salt and half the oil and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes, then rest and slice. Cook the bulgur in 360 ml of water for 12 minutes. Blanch the green beans for 4 minutes and toss with garlic and the rest of the oil.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff with buckwheat
recipes.description: Strips of beef with mushrooms in sour cream sauce, served with buckwheat.
recipes.instructions: Cook the buckwheat in 450 ml of water. Fry the beef strips in hot oil for 3 minutes and set aside. Fry the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes, stir in the flour, then the sour cream and 100 ml of water. Return the beef, salt and warm for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Shrimp fried rice
recipes.description: Rice stir-fried with shrimp, egg, peas and carrot.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice and cool it. Scramble the eggs in a little oil and set aside. Stir-fry the shrimp for 3 minutes, add carrot and peas for 3 minutes, then the rice, eggs, soy sauce and sesame oil. Finish with green onion.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable wrap
recipes.description: Tortilla with chicken, crisp vegetables and garlic yogurt sauce.
recipes.instructions: Fry the chicken in oil for 6 minutes per side and slice. Mix the yogurt with grated garlic. Fill the tortillas with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, chicken and sauce and roll up.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with sweet potato and broccoli
recipes.description: One-tray dinner of salmon, sweet potato and broccoli.
recipes.instructions: Toss the sweet potato cubes with half the oil and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes. Add the broccoli and the salmon, season with salt, pepper and the rest of the oil and bake for 12 more minutes. Squeeze over the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Chicken roll with ricotta and Brussels sprouts
recipes.description: Chicken breast rolled around ricotta and spinach, roasted with Brussels sprouts.
recipes.instructions: Butterfly and flatten the chicken breasts, season with salt. Mix the ricotta with chopped spinach and garlic, spread over the chicken and roll up. Roast at 190 °C for 30 minutes with the halved sprouts tossed in olive oil.

recipes.name: Turkey stuffed peppers
recipes.description: Peppers stuffed with turkey and rice, baked in tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice for 10 minutes. Fry the onion and carrot, mix with the turkey, rice and salt. Stuff the halved peppers, pour over the tomatoes and bake covered at 190 °C for 40 minutes. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Mediterranean baked cod
recipes.description: Cod baked on zucchini, tomatoes and red onion.
recipes.instructions: Slice the zucchini and red onion, halve the tomatoes and toss with oil, oregano and salt in a baking dish. Lay the cod on top, drizzle with lemon juice and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef stir-fry with rice noodles
recipes.description: Beef and crunchy vegetables with ginger and soy sauce.
recipes.instructions: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes and drain. Stir-fry the beef strips in oil for 2 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry broccoli, pepper and carrot for 4 minutes with ginger and garlic, add the beef, noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss.

recipes.name: Tofu and edamame stir-fry with brown rice
recipes.description: Crispy tofu with broccoli, pepper and edamame.
recipes.instructions: Cook the brown rice. Fry the tofu cubes in sesame oil until golden. Add broccoli, pepper and edamame with ginger and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Add soy sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken thighs with roasted vegetables
recipes.description: Paprika chicken thighs roasted with potato, carrot and onion.
recipes.instructions: Toss the potato, carrot and onion wedges with half the oil and salt. Rub the chicken with paprika, garlic, salt and the rest of the oil. Roast everything at 200 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Trout with quinoa and asparagus
recipes.description: Pan-seared trout with lemony quinoa and asparagus.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes. Season the trout with salt and fry skin side down in half the oil for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 2 minutes. Fry the asparagus in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes. Dress the quinoa with lemon juice and dill.

recipes.name: Pasta with turkey bolognese
recipes.description: Lean turkey ragù with carrot and basil over pasta.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot and garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add the turkey and brown it. Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 25 minutes. Cook the pasta and toss with the sauce, basil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Eggplant and chickpea stew with couscous
recipes.description: Spiced eggplant, chickpeas and tomatoes over couscous.
recipes.instructions: Fry the eggplant cubes in olive oil for 8 minutes, add onion and garlic for 4 minutes, then cumin and paprika. Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes. Pour boiling water over the couscous and leave for 5 minutes. Serve with parsley.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp with cauliflower rice
recipes.description: A low-carb dinner of buttery garlic shrimp on cauliflower rice.
recipes.instructions: Grate the cauliflower and fry it in half the butter for 6 minutes with salt. Fry the shrimp with garlic in the rest of the butter for 3-4 minutes, add lemon juice and parsley and serve over the cauliflower.

recipes.name: Beef and bean chili
recipes.description: Lean beef chili with kidney beans and peppers.
recipes.instructions: Brown the beef in oil, add onion, pepper and garlic and fry for 5 minutes. Add the chili powder and cumin, then the tomatoes, beans and salt. Simmer covered for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Buckwheat with chicken and mushrooms
recipes.description: One-pot buckwheat with chicken, mushrooms and carrot.
recipes.instructions: Fry the chicken pieces in oil for 5 minutes, add onion, carrot and mushrooms and fry for 8 minutes. Add the buckwheat, broth and salt, cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Tilapia with bulgur and tomato salad
recipes.description: Pan-fried tilapia with bulgur, tomato and cucumber salad.
recipes.instructions: Cook the bulgur in 320 ml of water for 12 minutes. Season the tilapia with salt and fry in half the oil for 3 minutes per side. Dice tomatoes and cucumber, dress with the rest of the oil, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.name: Pork with braised cabbage
recipes.description: Pork tenderloin braised with cabbage, carrot and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Brown the pork pieces in oil. Add onion and carrot for 5 minutes, then the shredded cabbage, tomato paste, salt and 150 ml of water. Cover and braise for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffed sweet potatoes with black beans
recipes.description: Baked sweet potatoes filled with beans, corn, salsa and yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Bake the sweet potatoes at 200 °C for 45 minutes. Warm the beans and corn with cumin. Split the potatoes, fill with the beans, corn, salsa and cheddar and top with yogurt.

recipes.name: Apple with peanut butter
recipes.description: Apple slices with a spoon of peanut butter.
recipes.instructions: Core and slice the apple and serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted chickpeas
recipes.description: Oven-roasted chickpeas with smoked paprika.
recipes.instructions: Pat the chickpeas dry, toss with oil, paprika and salt and roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes, shaking the tray halfway.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with cucumber and dill
recipes.description: Savoury cottage cheese with fresh cucumber, dill and garlic.
recipes.instructions: Mix the cottage cheese with diced cucumber, chopped dill, grated garlic and salt.

recipes.name: Date and cocoa energy balls
recipes.description: No-bake balls of dates, oats, almonds and cocoa.
recipes.instructions: Blend the almonds and oats into crumbs, add the dates, cocoa and peanut butter and blend into a sticky mass. Roll into 16 balls and chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Strawberry banana smoothie
recipes.description: A thick smoothie with yogurt, milk and oats.
recipes.instructions: Blend the yogurt, banana, strawberries, milk and oats until smooth.

recipes.name: Green mango smoothie
recipes.description: Spinach, mango and banana on almond milk.
recipes.instructions: Blend the spinach, mango, banana, almond milk and chia seeds until smooth.

recipes.name: Boiled eggs with fresh vegetables
recipes.description: Two boiled eggs with cherry tomatoes and cucumber.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Serve with tomatoes, cucumber sticks and a pinch of salt.

recipes.name: Nut and dried fruit mix
recipes.description: Almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, raisins and apricots.
recipes.instructions: Chop the apricots and mix with the nuts, seeds and raisins. Divide into 5 portions.

recipes.name: Tuna stuffed avocado
recipes.description: Avocado halves filled with a light tuna salad.
recipes.instructions: Mix the tuna with yogurt, finely chopped red onion, lemon juice and salt. Halve and pit the avocados and fill them with the tuna.

recipes.name: Ricotta toast with pear and honey
recipes.description: Wholegrain toast with ricotta, pear, walnuts and honey.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread, spread with ricotta, top with sliced pear and walnuts and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese waffles
recipes.description: Belgian-style waffles made with cottage cheese.
recipes.instructions: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs and honey, stir in the flour and baking powder. Bake in a buttered waffle iron for 4-5 minutes each.

recipes.name: Edamame with sesame
recipes.description: Steamed edamame with sesame oil and salt.
recipes.instructions: Boil the edamame for 5 minutes, drain and toss with sesame oil and salt.

recipes.name: Lazy varenyky
recipes.description: Soft cottage cheese dumplings with butter and sour cream.
recipes.instructions: Mash the cottage cheese with the egg, sugar and salt, then knead in the flour. Roll into a log, cut into small pieces and boil in salted water for 3 minutes after they float. Toss with butter and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Cornmeal porridge with feta
recipes.description: Hutsul-style mamalyha with butter and crumbled feta.
recipes.instructions: Bring the water with salt to a boil and pour in the cornmeal in a thin stream, whisking. Cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often. Stir in the butter and serve topped with crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Sweet potato hash with eggs
recipes.description: Crispy sweet potato, pepper and onion with fried eggs.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced sweet potato in olive oil for 10 minutes. Add the onion, pepper, paprika and salt and fry for 6 more minutes. Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt with homemade granola and kiwi
recipes.description: Crunchy honey-almond granola over yogurt with kiwi.
recipes.instructions: Mix the oats, chopped almonds, honey and melted coconut oil and bake at 170 °C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and serve over the yogurt with sliced kiwi.

recipes.name: Ham and cheese omelette
recipes.description: A fluffy omelette with ham, Swiss cheese and chives.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk and salt. Melt the butter, pour in the eggs and cook for 2 minutes. Add the diced ham and cheese to one half, fold and cook for 1 more minute. Sprinkle with chives.

recipes.name: Egg white omelette with vegetables
recipes.description: A light egg white omelette with tomato, spinach and mozzarella.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the egg whites with salt. Wilt the spinach in olive oil, add the diced tomato, pour over the whites and scatter the mozzarella. Cover and cook on low heat for 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Oat bran porridge with blackberries
recipes.description: Quick oat bran porridge on milk with fresh blackberries.
recipes.instructions: Bring the milk to a simmer, whisk in the oat bran and cook for 3 minutes, stirring. Serve topped with blackberries and honey.

recipes.name: Sourdough toast with sardines and tomato
recipes.description: Toasted sourdough with sardines, tomato and red onion.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Top with sliced tomato, the sardines and thin red onion, drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Breakfast tacos with eggs and black beans
recipes.description: Corn tortillas with scrambled eggs, beans, avocado and salsa.
recipes.instructions: Scramble the eggs over medium heat. Warm the beans and the tortillas. Fill the tortillas with eggs, beans, sliced avocado and salsa and sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.name: Baked oatmeal with berries
recipes.description: Oven-baked oatmeal with banana and mixed berries.
recipes.instructions: Mash the banana, whisk in the milk, egg, maple syrup, cinnamon and baking powder and stir in the oats. Fold in the berries, pour into a dish and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Whole wheat buttermilk pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy wholemeal pancakes with yogurt and strawberries.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and baking soda. Add the buttermilk, egg and oil and stir until just combined. Fry small pancakes on a hot pan, 2 minutes per side. Serve with yogurt and sliced strawberries.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage and potato skillet
recipes.description: Pan-fried potatoes with turkey sausage, onion and pepper.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced potato in oil for 12 minutes. Add the sliced sausage, onion and green pepper and fry for 8 minutes, stirring. Season with salt.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon quinoa porridge
recipes.description: Quinoa simmered in almond milk with apple and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in the almond milk with the diced apple and cinnamon for 15 minutes. Sweeten with maple syrup and top with chopped walnuts.

recipes.name: Spinach and goat cheese egg muffins
recipes.description: Baked egg cups with spinach, tomatoes and goat cheese.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt. Divide the chopped spinach, halved tomatoes and goat cheese between 12 muffin cups, pour in the eggs and bake at 180 °C for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Berry smoothie bowl
recipes.description: Thick berry and yogurt smoothie topped with oats, chia and coconut.
recipes.instructions: Blend the frozen berries, banana and yogurt until thick. Pour into bowls and top with oats, chia seeds and coconut.

recipes.name: Tahini toast with banana
recipes.description: Wholegrain toast with tahini, banana, honey and sesame.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread, spread with tahini, top with sliced banana, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Egg and avocado breakfast salad
recipes.description: Arugula with soft-boiled eggs, avocado and cherry tomatoes.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and halve. Toss the arugula and tomatoes with olive oil, lemon juice and salt and top with sliced avocado and the eggs.

recipes.name: Crepes with mushrooms and cheese
recipes.description: Thin crepes filled with fried mushrooms and melted Swiss cheese.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs, salt and half the oil into a thin batter and cook 8 crepes. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the rest of the oil for 10 minutes. Fill the crepes with the mushrooms and cheese, fold and warm for 1 minute per side.

recipes.name: Coconut rice pudding with mango
recipes.description: Creamy vegan rice pudding with cardamom and mango.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the rice in the coconut and almond milk with the cardamom for 25 minutes, stirring often, until creamy. Sweeten with maple syrup and serve with diced mango.

recipes.name: Pita with eggs and vegetables
recipes.description: Pita pockets with boiled eggs, tomato, cucumber and dill yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and slice. Mix the yogurt with dill and salt. Fill the pita with eggs, sliced tomato and cucumber and the yogurt sauce.

recipes.name: Ukrainian borscht
recipes.description: Red beet soup with beef, cabbage and potato, served with sour cream.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the beef in the water for 60 minutes, skimming. Fry the onion, carrot and grated beet in oil for 10 minutes, add the tomato paste and vinegar. Add the potato to the broth for 10 minutes, then the cabbage and the beet mix and cook for 15 minutes. Add garlic, bay leaf and salt, rest for 15 minutes and serve with dill and sour cream.

recipes.name: Green spinach soup with egg
recipes.description: Light green borscht with spinach, potato and boiled egg.
recipes.instructions: Cook the potato, onion and carrot in the broth for 15 minutes. Add the chopped spinach and salt and cook for 5 minutes. Serve with halved boiled eggs, dill and sour cream.

recipes.name: Butternut squash soup with coconut
recipes.description: Velvety vegan squash soup with ginger and toasted pumpkin seeds.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot, garlic and ginger in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add the diced squash and broth and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the coconut milk and salt and blend until smooth. Serve sprinkled with toasted pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: White bean and kale soup
recipes.description: Tuscan-style bean soup with kale, tomatoes and thyme.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 7 minutes. Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes. Add the chopped kale and salt and cook for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Holubtsi (cabbage rolls)
recipes.description: Cabbage leaves stuffed with beef and rice, stewed in tomato and sour cream.
recipes.instructions: Blanch the cabbage leaves for 3 minutes. Fry the onion and carrot in oil, mix half with the beef, half-cooked rice and salt. Wrap the filling in the leaves, lay them in a pot, cover with the rest of the vegetables, tomato puree, sour cream and water and stew covered for 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma bowl
recipes.description: Spiced chicken thighs over bulgur with salad and tahini sauce.
recipes.instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, garlic, cumin, paprika, half the lemon juice and salt for 15 minutes, then fry in oil for 6 minutes per side and slice. Cook the bulgur in the water for 12 minutes. Serve with chopped cucumber, tomato, red onion and parsley, drizzled with tahini mixed with the rest of the lemon juice.

recipes.name: Baked falafel in pita
recipes.description: Oven-baked chickpea patties with salad and tahini in pita.
recipes.instructions: Blend the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, cumin, flour and salt into a coarse paste. Shape 16 patties, brush with oil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, turning once. Fill the pita with falafel, tomato, cucumber and tahini thinned with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Salmon poke bowl
recipes.description: Rice bowl with salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice and season with the vinegar. Dice the salmon and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil. Boil the edamame for 4 minutes. Arrange rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado in bowls and sprinkle with sesame and green onion.

recipes.name: Beef and rice noodle soup
recipes.description: Pho-style broth with thin beef, rice noodles and herbs.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the broth with the halved onion, sliced ginger and cinnamon for 20 minutes and strain. Add the fish sauce. Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes. Put noodles, raw thin beef slices and bean sprouts in bowls and pour over the boiling broth. Finish with cilantro and lime juice.

recipes.name: Green pea soup with mint
recipes.description: Bright green pea soup with potato and fresh mint.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion in oil for 5 minutes, add the potato and broth and cook for 12 minutes. Add the peas and cook for 4 minutes. Add the mint and salt, blend and serve with a spoon of yogurt.

recipes.name: Tuna niçoise salad
recipes.description: Potato, green beans, egg, tomatoes and tuna with mustard dressing.
recipes.instructions: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes and the eggs for 9 minutes, blanch the green beans for 4 minutes. Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt. Arrange lettuce, sliced potatoes, beans, halved eggs, tomatoes, olives and tuna and pour over the dressing.

recipes.name: Light chicken caesar salad
recipes.description: Romaine, grilled chicken and croutons with a yogurt caesar dressing.
recipes.instructions: Grill the chicken for 6 minutes per side and slice. Toast the bread cubes with the olive oil. Whisk the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, mustard, salt and half the parmesan. Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Pasta primavera
recipes.description: Pasta with spring vegetables, garlic, parmesan and basil.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli and peas for the last 3 minutes. Fry the zucchini and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes for 2 minutes. Toss with the drained pasta, salt, parmesan and basil.

recipes.name: Mushroom and barley soup (krupnyk)
recipes.description: Hearty soup with pearl barley, mushrooms and potato.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the barley and simmer it in the water for 30 minutes. Fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms in oil for 10 minutes. Add them with the potato to the pot and cook for 20 minutes. Season with salt and dill.

recipes.name: Chicken plov
recipes.description: Rice pilaf with chicken thighs, lots of carrot, garlic and cumin.
recipes.instructions: Brown the chicken pieces in oil, add the onion and the carrot cut in strips and fry for 10 minutes. Add the cumin, salt and water and bring to a boil. Spread the rinsed rice on top, push in the whole garlic, cover and cook on low heat for 25 minutes without stirring.

recipes.name: Quinoa tabbouleh with chickpeas
recipes.description: Herby quinoa salad with chickpeas, tomato and cucumber.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes and cool. Chop the parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and red onion. Toss everything with the chickpeas, olive oil, lemon juice and salt.

recipes.name: Chicken pesto pasta
recipes.description: Pasta with chicken, pesto, cherry tomatoes and arugula.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta. Season the chicken with salt and fry in oil for 6 minutes per side, then slice. Toss the pasta with pesto, halved tomatoes, chicken and arugula.

recipes.name: Teriyaki shrimp noodles
recipes.description: Egg noodles stir-fried with shrimp, snow peas and pepper.
recipes.instructions: Cook the noodles. Stir-fry the shrimp in oil for 3 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry the carrot, pepper, snow peas, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes. Add the noodles, shrimp and teriyaki sauce and toss. Sprinkle with green onion.

recipes.name: Deruny (potato pancakes)
recipes.description: Crispy Ukrainian potato pancakes with sour cream.
recipes.instructions: Finely grate the potato and onion and squeeze out the liquid. Mix with the egg, flour and salt. Fry spoonfuls in hot oil for 3-4 minutes per side. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Varenyky with potato and fried onion
recipes.description: Ukrainian dumplings filled with mashed potato, topped with fried onion.
recipes.instructions: Knead the flour, water, a spoon of oil and salt into a soft dough and rest for 20 minutes. Boil and mash the potato. Fry the onion in the rest of the oil until golden and mix a third of it into the potato. Roll the dough thin, cut circles, fill and seal. Boil for 5 minutes after they float and serve with the rest of the onion.

recipes.name: Lamb and white bean stew
recipes.description: Slow-cooked lamb with white beans, tomatoes and rosemary.
recipes.instructions: Brown the lamb pieces in olive oil, add the onion, carrot and garlic and fry for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, broth, rosemary and salt, cover and simmer for 60 minutes. Add the beans and cook for 15 more minutes.

recipes.name: Haddock with mashed potato and peas
recipes.description: Pan-fried haddock with creamy mash and buttered peas.
recipes.instructions: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with the hot milk, half the butter and salt. Cook the peas for 4 minutes. Fry the seasoned haddock in the rest of the butter for 3 minutes per side, drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with dill.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
recipes.description: Spiced chicken strips with peppers and onion in corn tortillas.
recipes.instructions: Toss the chicken strips with chili powder, cumin, salt and lime juice. Fry in oil for 5 minutes, add the sliced peppers and onion and fry for 6 more minutes. Serve in warm tortillas with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with apples and red cabbage
recipes.description: Roasted pork with sweet-sour braised red cabbage and apples.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion in half the oil, add the shredded cabbage, sliced apples, vinegar and half the salt and braise covered for 30 minutes. Rub the pork with thyme, salt and the rest of the oil and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Slice and serve with the cabbage.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon with rice and bok choy
recipes.description: Glazed salmon with steamed rice and garlicky bok choy.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Brush the salmon with teriyaki sauce and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes. Stir-fry the bok choy with ginger in sesame oil for 3 minutes. Serve sprinkled with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Turkey stuffed zucchini boats
recipes.description: Zucchini halves filled with turkey in marinara, baked with mozzarella.
recipes.instructions: Halve the zucchini and scoop out the middle. Fry the onion, garlic and chopped zucchini flesh in oil, add the turkey and brown. Stir in the marinara and salt. Fill the zucchini, top with mozzarella and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with brown rice
recipes.description: Tikka-style chicken in a spiced tomato and yogurt sauce.
recipes.instructions: Cook the brown rice. Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt with curry powder, ginger, garlic and salt. Fry the onion in oil for 6 minutes, add the chicken and fry for 5 minutes. Add the tomato puree and simmer for 15 minutes, then stir in the rest of the yogurt off the heat. Serve with cilantro.

recipes.name: Mussels in tomato and garlic sauce
recipes.description: Mussels cooked in tomato, shallot and garlic with sourdough.
recipes.instructions: Fry the shallot and garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes, add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the mussels, cover and cook for 5-6 minutes until they open. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with toasted sourdough.

recipes.name: Mushroom barley risotto
recipes.description: Creamy pearl barley with mushrooms, thyme and parmesan.
recipes.instructions: Fry the shallot, garlic and mushrooms in olive oil for 8 minutes. Add the barley and thyme, then the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for 40 minutes until creamy. Stir in the parmesan and salt.

recipes.name: Beef stew with root vegetables
recipes.description: Tender beef braised with potato, carrot and parsnip.
recipes.instructions: Toss the beef in the flour and brown it in oil. Add the onion and tomato paste, then the broth, bay leaf, thyme and salt. Cover and simmer for 80 minutes. Add the potato, carrot and parsnip and cook for 30 more minutes.

recipes.name: Black bean burgers with sweet potato wedges
recipes.description: Baked bean patties with oven sweet potato wedges and lettuce.
recipes.instructions: Toss the sweet potato wedges with half the oil and salt and bake at 210 °C for 35 minutes. Mash the beans with the oats, grated onion, garlic, cumin, egg and the rest of the salt. Shape 8 patties and fry in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes per side. Serve with lettuce.

recipes.name: Halibut with fennel and orange
recipes.description: Halibut baked on sliced fennel with orange and olives.
recipes.instructions: Toss the sliced fennel with half the oil and salt and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes. Add the halibut, orange segments, olives and thyme, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake for 12 more minutes.

recipes.name: Pork and green bean stir-fry
recipes.description: Ground pork stir-fried with green beans, ginger and chili, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the pork in oil until browned. Add the green beans, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 6 minutes. Add the soy sauce and sriracha and toss. Serve with rice and green onion.

recipes.name: Chicken meatballs with zucchini noodles
recipes.description: Baked chicken meatballs in marinara over zucchini noodles.
recipes.instructions: Mix the chicken with the egg, breadcrumbs, garlic, parmesan and salt and shape 20 meatballs. Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes, then simmer in the marinara for 5 minutes. Fry the spiralized zucchini in olive oil for 2 minutes and serve with the meatballs and basil.

recipes.name: Seafood paella
recipes.description: Saffron-yellow rice with shrimp, squid, mussels, peppers and peas.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes, add the paprika and turmeric. Add the rice and tomatoes, then the broth and salt and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes. Press in the shrimp, squid rings, mussels and peas, cover and cook for 8 minutes. Serve with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Lentil shepherd's pie
recipes.description: Vegan lentil and mushroom filling under a mashed potato crust.
recipes.instructions: Boil the potatoes and mash with the almond milk, half the oil and salt. Fry the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms in the rest of the oil for 8 minutes, add the tomato paste, lentils, broth and thyme and simmer for 25 minutes. Spread in a dish, cover with the mash and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Garlic chicken drumsticks with buckwheat
recipes.description: Roasted paprika drumsticks with buckwheat and cucumber salad.
recipes.instructions: Rub the drumsticks with garlic, paprika, salt and oil and roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes. Cook the buckwheat in water for 15 minutes. Mix the sliced cucumber with dill and sour cream.

recipes.name: Coconut tofu curry with rice
recipes.description: Vegan curry of tofu, pepper, zucchini and green beans in coconut milk.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in oil for 4 minutes, add the curry powder. Add the coconut milk, tofu cubes, pepper, zucchini, green beans and salt and simmer for 12 minutes. Finish with lime juice.

recipes.name: Baked flounder with potatoes and dill
recipes.description: Flounder fillets baked over thin potato slices with lemon and dill.
recipes.instructions: Toss the thinly sliced potatoes with the oil, garlic and half the salt and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes. Lay the flounder on top, season with the rest of the salt and the lemon juice and bake for 10 minutes. Sprinkle with dill.

recipes.name: Stuffed portobello mushrooms with quinoa
recipes.description: Portobellos filled with spinach, feta and sun-dried tomatoes, with quinoa.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa. Wilt the spinach with garlic in half the oil, mix with the feta, chopped sun-dried tomatoes and pine nuts. Brush the mushrooms with the rest of the oil and salt, fill and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes. Serve with the quinoa.

recipes.name: Flank steak with chimichurri and potatoes
recipes.description: Grilled flank steak with parsley chimichurri and roasted potatoes.
recipes.instructions: Toss the potato wedges with a third of the oil and half the salt and roast at 210 °C for 35 minutes. Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, oregano and the rest of the oil. Season the steak with the rest of the salt and grill for 4-5 minutes per side, rest and slice across the grain. Spoon over the chimichurri.

recipes.name: Baked kale chips
recipes.description: Crisp oven-baked kale with olive oil and smoked paprika.
recipes.instructions: Tear the kale off the stems, toss with the oil, paprika and salt and bake in one layer at 150 °C for 15-18 minutes until crisp.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt with figs and pistachios
recipes.description: Yogurt topped with chopped dried figs and pistachios.
recipes.instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with the chopped figs and pistachios.

recipes.name: Kiwi, orange and pomegranate salad
recipes.description: Fresh fruit salad with mint and a spoon of yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Peel and slice the kiwi and orange, sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and chopped mint. Serve with yogurt.

recipes.name: Baked apples with cottage cheese
recipes.description: Apples stuffed with cottage cheese and raisins, baked with cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: Core the apples. Mix the cottage cheese with the raisins, honey and cinnamon, fill the apples and bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Banana oat cookies
recipes.description: Two-ingredient cookies with raisins, walnuts and cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: Mash the bananas and mix with the oats, raisins, chopped walnuts and cinnamon. Shape 16 cookies and bake at 180 °C for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter cocoa smoothie
recipes.description: A filling smoothie with milk, yogurt, banana, peanut butter and cocoa.
recipes.instructions: Blend the milk, yogurt, banana, peanut butter and cocoa until smooth.

recipes.name: Dark chocolate with almonds
recipes.description: A small square of dark chocolate with a handful of almonds.
recipes.instructions: Serve the chocolate with the almonds.

recipes.name: Guacamole with baked tortilla chips
recipes.description: Chunky guacamole with oven-baked corn tortilla chips.
recipes.instructions: Cut the tortillas into wedges, brush with the oil and bake at 190 °C for 10 minutes. Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt and stir in the diced tomato, red onion, jalapeño and cilantro.

recipes.name: Tzatziki with warm pita
recipes.description: Cucumber yogurt dip with garlic and dill, served with pita.
recipes.instructions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the juice. Mix with the yogurt, garlic, dill, olive oil, lemon juice and salt. Serve with warm pita wedges.

recipes.name: Watermelon and feta salad
recipes.description: Watermelon, cucumber and feta with mint and lime.
recipes.instructions: Cube the watermelon and cucumber, crumble over the feta, sprinkle with mint and drizzle with lime juice.

recipes.name: Egg salad lettuce cups
recipes.description: Creamy egg salad with yogurt and chives in lettuce leaves.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and chop. Mix with the yogurt, mustard, chives and salt and spoon into the lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with peach and almonds
recipes.description: Cottage cheese with sliced peach and toasted almonds.
recipes.instructions: Top the cottage cheese with the sliced peach and chopped almonds.

recipes.name: Celery with peanut butter and raisins
recipes.description: Crunchy celery sticks filled with peanut butter and raisins.
recipes.instructions: Cut the celery into sticks, fill with peanut butter and dot with raisins.

recipes.name: Chocolate chia pudding with raspberries
recipes.description: Vegan cocoa chia pudding on almond milk.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the almond milk with the cocoa and maple syrup, stir in the chia seeds and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Serve with raspberries.

recipes.name: Seed and cranberry oat bars
recipes.description: No-bake oat bars with pumpkin and sunflower seeds and cranberries.
recipes.instructions: Warm the honey with the peanut butter and cinnamon until smooth. Stir in the oats, seeds and cranberries, press into a lined tin and chill for 2 hours. Cut into 10 bars.

recipes.name: Radish, cucumber and egg salad
recipes.description: Spring salad of radish, cucumber and egg with sour cream and dill.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and chop. Slice the radish, cucumber and green onion and mix with the eggs, dill, sour cream and salt.

recipes.name: Pineapple and spinach smoothie
recipes.description: Vegan green smoothie with pineapple, banana and ginger.
recipes.instructions: Blend the pineapple, spinach, banana, ginger, lime juice and cold water until smooth.

recipes.name: Overnight oats with almond milk and blueberries
recipes.description: Oats soaked overnight in almond milk with chia and blueberries.
recipes.instructions: Mix the oats, chia seeds and almond milk in a jar. Fold in the blueberries, cover and refrigerate overnight. Serve cold topped with chopped walnuts and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Buckwheat porridge with pear and walnuts
recipes.description: Buckwheat cooked in water, topped with a warm cinnamon pear and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the buckwheat, cover with the water and a pinch of salt, bring to a boil and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Warm the diced pear with the cinnamon and a splash of water for 5 minutes. Serve the buckwheat topped with the pear, walnuts and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Vegan banana oat pancakes
recipes.description: Egg-free pancakes from blended oats, banana and almond milk.
recipes.instructions: Blend the oats into flour, add the bananas, almond milk, baking powder and cinnamon and blend into a thick batter. Rest for 5 minutes. Fry small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes per side. Serve with blueberries and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Smashed chickpea and avocado toast
recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast with lemony smashed chickpeas, avocado and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Mash the chickpeas and avocado with the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Spread on the toast and top with sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana toast with chia
recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast with peanut butter, banana and chia seeds.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread and spread with peanut butter. Top with sliced banana, sprinkle with chia seeds and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Cornmeal porridge with raspberries and pumpkin seeds
recipes.description: Creamy polenta-style porridge on almond milk with berries.
recipes.instructions: Bring the almond milk and water to a simmer, whisk in the cornmeal in a thin stream and cook for 10-12 minutes, stirring, until thick. Sweeten with maple syrup. Serve topped with raspberries and pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Tofu and black bean breakfast burrito
recipes.description: Flour tortillas filled with turmeric tofu scramble, black beans, spinach and salsa.
recipes.instructions: Crumble the tofu into a hot oiled pan, add the turmeric and salt and cook for 5 minutes. Add the black beans and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts. Warm the tortillas, fill with the scramble and salsa and roll up.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and black bean hash
recipes.description: Pan-fried sweet potato with black beans, pepper and avocado.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced sweet potato in the oil for 10 minutes, stirring. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 8 minutes more. Stir in the beans and paprika, season and heat through. Serve with sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Raspberry almond chia pudding
recipes.description: Chia seeds set in almond milk, layered with raspberries and almonds.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the chia seeds with the almond milk and maple syrup, rest for 10 minutes, whisk again and refrigerate for at least 4 hours. Layer with mashed raspberries and top with chopped almonds.

recipes.name: Oat bran porridge with apple and raisins
recipes.description: Oat bran cooked in almond milk with grated apple, raisins and flax.
recipes.instructions: Bring the water and almond milk to a simmer, stir in the oat bran and cook for 5 minutes. Add the grated apple, raisins and cinnamon and cook for 2 minutes more. Serve sprinkled with ground flaxseed.

recipes.name: Pita with homemade hummus and vegetables
recipes.description: Warm pita with quick chickpea hummus, cucumber and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Blend the chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and salt until smooth. Warm the pita, spread with the hummus, drizzle with olive oil and fill with sliced cucumber and tomato.

recipes.name: Tofu scramble with crispy potatoes
recipes.description: Turmeric tofu scramble with pan-fried potatoes, pepper and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced potatoes in the oil for 15 minutes until golden. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 5 minutes. Crumble in the tofu with the turmeric, paprika and salt and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.

recipes.name: Black bean and quinoa salad
recipes.description: Quinoa with black beans, corn, pepper and a lime-cumin dressing.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the quinoa, cook in the water for 15 minutes and cool. Cook the corn for 3 minutes and cool. Mix with the beans, diced pepper, red onion and coriander. Dress with the lime juice, olive oil, cumin, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Vegetable minestrone with white beans
recipes.description: Tomato vegetable soup with pasta and white beans.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the zucchini, beans and pasta and cook for 10 minutes more. Season and serve with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Rice noodle salad with tofu and peanut dressing
recipes.description: Rice noodles, crisp vegetables and tofu in a peanut-lime dressing.
recipes.instructions: Soak or cook the rice noodles as the pack says, rinse cold. Cut the tofu into cubes and brown in the sesame oil. Shred the carrot, cucumber and cabbage. Whisk the peanut butter with the lime juice, soy sauce and water. Toss everything with the dressing and coriander.

recipes.name: Three-bean chili with rice
recipes.description: Meat-free chili of kidney and black beans, corn and peppers, served with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer for 25 minutes. Season and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable couscous with chickpeas
recipes.description: Couscous with roasted zucchini, eggplant, peppers and chickpeas.
recipes.instructions: Cut the vegetables into chunks, toss with half the oil, salt and pepper and roast at 220 C for 25 minutes. Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Mix with the vegetables, chickpeas, lemon juice, the rest of the oil and parsley.

recipes.name: Creamy broccoli and potato soup
recipes.description: Blended broccoli and potato soup with almond milk and pumpkin seeds.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic. Add the diced potatoes and broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the broccoli and cook for 8 minutes. Blend with the almond milk, season and serve with pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Edamame brown rice bowl
recipes.description: Brown rice with edamame, crunchy vegetables, avocado and sesame.
recipes.instructions: Cook the brown rice for 30 minutes. Boil the edamame for 4 minutes. Shred the carrot and cabbage, slice the cucumber and avocado. Mix the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil. Arrange everything over the rice, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese pasta
recipes.description: Pasta with a rich tomato sauce of brown lentils and vegetables.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and grated carrot in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and oregano. Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and water and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft. Cook the pasta, toss with the sauce and serve with basil.

recipes.name: Peppers stuffed with rice and beans
recipes.description: Bell peppers stuffed with rice, kidney beans and vegetables, baked in tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions: Parboil the rice for 8 minutes. Fry the onion and carrot in the oil, mix with the rice, beans, paprika and seasoning. Halve and seed the peppers and fill them. Pour over the tomato puree mixed with the water, cover and bake at 190 C for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Teriyaki tofu with broccoli and rice
recipes.description: Crispy tofu and broccoli glazed with teriyaki, ginger and garlic.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Cube the tofu and fry in the sesame oil until golden. Add the broccoli florets, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 5 minutes. Pour in the teriyaki sauce and toss for 1 minute. Serve over the rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Cauliflower and chickpea curry
recipes.description: Cauliflower and chickpeas simmered in a coconut-tomato curry, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and cauliflower florets and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Add the chickpeas for 5 minutes. Serve with the rice and coriander.

recipes.name: Buckwheat with fried mushrooms and onion
recipes.description: Ukrainian-style buckwheat with mushrooms, onion, carrot and dill.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the buckwheat, cover with the salted water and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Fry the onion and grated carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes, then the garlic. Mix with the buckwheat and serve with dill.

recipes.name: Black bean and sweet potato tacos
recipes.description: Corn tortillas with roasted sweet potato, black beans, cabbage and avocado.
recipes.instructions: Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin and salt and roast at 220 C for 25 minutes. Warm the beans. Shred the cabbage and toss with the lime juice. Warm the tortillas and fill with the sweet potato, beans, cabbage, avocado and salsa.

recipes.name: Ratatouille with white beans and quinoa
recipes.description: Slow-cooked Provencal vegetables with white beans over quinoa.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the cubed eggplant and pepper for 10 minutes, then the zucchini, garlic and thyme. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes, then the beans for 5 minutes. Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes and serve with the ratatouille.

recipes.name: Cabbage rolls with rice and mushrooms
recipes.description: Lenten holubtsi: cabbage leaves stuffed with rice, mushrooms and vegetables, stewed in tomato.
recipes.instructions: Blanch the cabbage head and separate the leaves. Parboil the rice for 8 minutes. Fry the onion, carrot and chopped mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes and mix with the rice and seasoning. Roll the filling in the leaves, lay in a pot, pour over the tomato puree with the water, add the bay leaf and stew covered for 45 minutes. Serve with dill.

recipes.name: Rice noodles with tofu and pak choi
recipes.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with tofu, pak choi, mushrooms and a soy-ginger sauce.
recipes.instructions: Soak or cook the noodles as the pack says. Brown the cubed tofu in the sesame oil and set aside. Stir-fry the mushrooms, garlic and ginger for 4 minutes, add the pak choi for 2 minutes. Add the noodles, tofu, soy sauce and sliced scallions and toss over high heat. Add sriracha to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable paella with chickpeas
recipes.description: Saffron-coloured rice with peppers, green beans, peas and chickpeas.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil in a wide pan for 6 minutes, add the garlic, paprika and turmeric. Stir in the rice and tomatoes, pour in the broth and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes. Add the green beans, peas and chickpeas and cook for 8 minutes more. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and chickpea buddha bowl
recipes.description: Quinoa with roasted sweet potato and chickpeas, kale and lemon tahini.
recipes.instructions: Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with the oil, paprika and salt and roast at 220 C for 25 minutes. Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes. Massage the chopped kale with a little lemon juice. Whisk the tahini with the rest of the lemon juice, garlic and water to taste. Assemble the bowls and drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.name: Arrabbiata pasta with white beans and spinach
recipes.description: Spicy tomato pasta with white beans and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta. Fry the garlic and chili in the oil for 1 minute, add the marinara sauce and beans and simmer for 8 minutes. Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Toss with the pasta and serve with basil.

recipes.name: Ricotta toast with figs and honey
recipes.description: Sourdough toast with ricotta, dried figs, walnuts and honey.
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Spread with ricotta, top with sliced figs and chopped walnuts and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Buckwheat pancakes with blueberries
recipes.description: Gluten-free pancakes from ground buckwheat, milk and eggs.
recipes.instructions: Grind the buckwheat into flour. Whisk with the milk, eggs and baking powder and rest for 10 minutes. Fry small pancakes in a buttered pan for 2 minutes per side. Serve with blueberries and honey.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon, egg and avocado bowl
recipes.description: Soft-boiled eggs with smoked salmon, avocado and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool and halve. Arrange the spinach, sliced avocado, smoked salmon and eggs in bowls. Dress with olive oil, lemon juice and pepper.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese bowl with peach and almonds
recipes.description: Cottage cheese with fresh peach, toasted almonds and honey.
recipes.instructions: Divide the cottage cheese between bowls, top with sliced peach and chopped toasted almonds and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage and egg breakfast wrap
recipes.description: Tortillas with turkey sausage, scrambled eggs, spinach and cheddar.
recipes.instructions: Brown the sliced sausage in a dry pan for 6 minutes. Add the beaten eggs and spinach and scramble. Fill the warmed tortillas with the scramble, grated cheddar and salsa and roll up.

recipes.name: Mushroom and spinach omelette
recipes.description: Three-egg omelette with mushrooms, spinach and cheddar.
recipes.instructions: Fry the sliced mushrooms in the butter for 5 minutes, add the spinach until it wilts. Pour in the beaten eggs, cook until almost set, sprinkle with cheddar, fold and serve.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt pancakes with strawberries
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes made with Greek yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the yogurt, eggs and milk, then mix in the flour and baking soda. Fry spoonfuls of batter in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes per side. Serve with sliced strawberries and honey.

recipes.name: Savory oatmeal with fried egg
recipes.description: Oats cooked in water with spinach and cheddar, topped with an egg.
recipes.instructions: Cook the oats in the salted water for 5 minutes, stir in the spinach and cheddar. Fry the eggs in the oil. Serve the oatmeal topped with an egg and sliced scallion.

recipes.name: Chocolate banana overnight oats
recipes.description: Vegan oats soaked with cocoa, banana and peanut butter.
recipes.instructions: Mash half of the banana and mix with the oats, almond milk, cocoa and chia. Refrigerate overnight. Serve with the rest of the banana, sliced, and the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon baked oats
recipes.description: Vegan baked oatmeal with apple, flax and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Mix the oats, ground flax, baking powder and cinnamon. Stir in the almond milk, maple syrup and diced apple. Pour into a baking dish, top with walnuts and bake at 190 C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Tofu shakshuka
recipes.description: Spiced tomato and pepper sauce with tofu, served with toast.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, cumin and paprika. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Add the tofu in thick slices and heat through for 5 minutes. Serve with toast and coriander.

recipes.name: Ham, Swiss cheese and egg sandwich
recipes.description: Whole-wheat sandwich with ham, Swiss cheese, egg and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Fry the eggs. Toast the bread and layer with ham, Swiss cheese, the eggs and sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Rye toast with tuna and egg
recipes.description: Rye bread with tuna, yogurt, cucumber and boiled egg.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and slice. Mix the tuna with the yogurt and dill. Spread on the rye bread and top with cucumber and egg.

recipes.name: Pear and ginger quinoa porridge
recipes.description: Quinoa cooked in almond milk with pear, ginger and almonds.
recipes.instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer with the almond milk, water, grated ginger and cinnamon for 15 minutes. Stir in the diced pear and cook for 3 minutes. Serve with chopped almonds and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Buttermilk blueberry pancakes
recipes.description: Classic buttermilk pancakes with blueberries.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the buttermilk, egg and melted butter, then mix in the flour, sugar and baking soda. Fold in the blueberries. Fry in a hot pan for 2 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Spinach, egg and feta quesadilla
recipes.description: Crisp tortillas filled with scrambled egg, spinach and feta.
recipes.instructions: Wilt the spinach in the oil, add the beaten eggs and scramble softly. Spread over a tortilla, crumble over the feta, cover with the second tortilla and toast for 2 minutes per side. Cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Yogurt bowl with oats and peach
recipes.description: Plain yogurt with oats, peach and pumpkin seeds.
recipes.instructions: Mix the yogurt with the oats and leave for 5 minutes. Top with sliced peach, pumpkin seeds and honey.

recipes.name: Savory quinoa breakfast bowl
recipes.description: Quinoa with black beans, avocado, tomato and lime.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes. Warm the beans with the chili. Fill bowls with quinoa, beans, diced tomato and avocado and finish with lime juice and coriander.

recipes.name: Potato and egg skillet with dill
recipes.description: Pan-fried potatoes with onion, eggs and dill.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced potatoes in the oil for 15 minutes, add the onion for 5 minutes. Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes. Sprinkle with dill and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Pumpkin spice chia pudding
recipes.description: Vegan chia pudding with pumpkin puree, cinnamon and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the pumpkin puree with the almond milk, maple syrup and cinnamon, stir in the chia seeds and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. Serve with chopped walnuts.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with smoked salmon and chives on sourdough.
recipes.instructions: Melt the butter over low heat, add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set. Fold in the smoked salmon and chives. Serve on toasted sourdough.

recipes.name: Mango coconut overnight oats
recipes.description: Vegan oats soaked in coconut and almond milk with mango.
recipes.instructions: Mix the oats, chia, coconut milk and almond milk and refrigerate overnight. Serve topped with diced mango and desiccated coconut.

recipes.name: Rye toast with cottage cheese and vegetables
recipes.description: Rye bread with dill cottage cheese, tomato and cucumber.
recipes.instructions: Mix the cottage cheese with chopped dill and salt. Spread on the rye bread and top with sliced tomato and cucumber.

recipes.name: Chicken and red lentil soup
recipes.description: Hearty soup of chicken, red lentils and vegetables with turmeric.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the diced chicken, lentils, turmeric and broth and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils break down. Season and serve.

recipes.name: Beef and barley soup
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef soup with pearl barley, potato and carrot.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the beef and barley in the broth with the bay leaf for 60 minutes. Add the diced potato, carrot and onion and cook for 20 minutes more. Season and serve.

recipes.name: Salmon quinoa salad
recipes.description: Baked salmon over quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes and arugula.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes and cool. Bake the salmon at 200 C for 12 minutes and flake. Toss the quinoa with the cucumber, halved tomatoes, arugula, lemon juice and oil, and top with the salmon.

recipes.name: Turkey and bean chili
recipes.description: Lean turkey chili with kidney beans and peppers.
recipes.instructions: Brown the turkey in the oil, add the onion and pepper for 6 minutes, then the chili powder and cumin. Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 30 minutes. Season and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken and hummus pita
recipes.description: Pita filled with grilled chicken, quick hummus and salad.
recipes.instructions: Rub the chicken with paprika, salt and half the oil and grill for 6 minutes per side, then slice. Blend the chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, the rest of the oil and water to taste. Fill the pitas with hummus, chicken and the vegetables.

recipes.name: Tuna and white bean salad
recipes.description: Tuna with white beans, tomatoes, red onion and arugula.
recipes.instructions: Drain the tuna and beans. Toss with the sliced red onion, halved tomatoes, parsley and arugula. Dress with the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Shrimp, avocado and corn salad
recipes.description: Seared shrimp with avocado, corn and tomatoes in a lime dressing.
recipes.instructions: Sear the shrimp in half the oil for 2 minutes per side. Cook the corn for 3 minutes. Toss the romaine, tomatoes, avocado and corn with the lime juice and remaining oil and top with the shrimp and coriander.

recipes.name: Green pea soup with ham
recipes.description: Pea and potato soup with diced ham.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and carrot in the butter for 5 minutes. Add the potato and broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the peas for 5 minutes, blend half of the soup and stir in the diced ham.

recipes.name: Greek lentil soup (fakes)
recipes.description: Brown lentils simmered with tomato, bay and a splash of vinegar.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic. Add the lentils, tomatoes, bay leaf and water and simmer for 35 minutes. Season and stir in the vinegar before serving.

recipes.name: Roasted beet and buckwheat salad
recipes.description: Warm buckwheat with roasted beets, arugula and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Roast the beets wrapped in foil at 200 C for 45 minutes, peel and dice. Cook the buckwheat in the water for 15 minutes. Toss with the beets, sliced onion, arugula and walnuts, and dress with the oil and vinegar.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken rice soup
recipes.description: Greek-style chicken and rice soup thickened with egg and lemon.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the chicken in the broth for 15 minutes, remove and shred. Cook the rice in the broth for 15 minutes. Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice, temper with a ladle of hot broth and stir into the pot off the heat. Add the chicken and dill.

recipes.name: Cod and potato chowder
recipes.description: Creamy milk chowder with cod, potato and dill.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and celery in the butter for 5 minutes, stir in the flour. Add the water and potatoes and simmer for 12 minutes. Add the milk and the cod in chunks and cook gently for 6 minutes. Season and add the dill.

recipes.name: Beef burrito bowl
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef with rice, black beans, corn and salsa.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Brown the beef with the cumin and chili for 8 minutes. Warm the beans and corn. Fill bowls with the rice, beef, beans, corn, shredded romaine, salsa and cheddar and finish with lime.

recipes.name: Caprese pasta salad
recipes.description: Pasta with mozzarella, cherry tomatoes and basil.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta, rinse and cool. Toss with the halved tomatoes, cubed mozzarella, arugula and torn basil. Dress with the oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with vegetables
recipes.description: Fried rice with eggs, peas, carrot and scallions.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice a day ahead or cool it well. Scramble the eggs in half the oil and set aside. Stir-fry the carrot and peas in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes, add the rice and soy sauce and fry for 5 minutes. Fold in the eggs and scallions.

recipes.name: Tofu pho
recipes.description: Ginger and cinnamon broth with rice noodles, tofu and pak choi.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the broth with the sliced ginger, cinnamon and soy sauce for 20 minutes. Cook the noodles. Add the cubed tofu and pak choi to the broth for 3 minutes. Pour over the noodles and top with the sprouts, scallions, coriander and lime.

recipes.name: Chicken couscous salad with feta
recipes.description: Couscous with grilled chicken, vegetables, feta and lemon.
recipes.instructions: Pour boiling water over the couscous and cover for 5 minutes. Grill the chicken for 6 minutes per side and slice. Toss the couscous with the diced vegetables, parsley, lemon juice and oil, and top with the chicken and feta.

recipes.name: Turkey and avocado wrap
recipes.description: Tortillas with cumin turkey, avocado, lettuce and yogurt sauce.
recipes.instructions: Brown the turkey with the cumin in the oil for 8 minutes and season. Spread the tortillas with yogurt, add the turkey, sliced avocado, lettuce and tomato and roll up.

recipes.name: Pork lo mein
recipes.description: Egg noodles stir-fried with pork, cabbage and carrot.
recipes.instructions: Cook the noodles. Stir-fry the thinly sliced pork in the sesame oil for 4 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, cabbage and carrot for 4 minutes. Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss. Finish with scallions.

recipes.name: Sardine and potato salad
recipes.description: Boiled potatoes with sardines, cucumber, red onion and mustard dressing.
recipes.instructions: Cut the potatoes and cucumber into chunks. Whisk the mustard, oil and lemon juice. Toss with the potatoes, cucumber, sliced onion and dill and top with the sardines.

recipes.name: Chickpea, kale and potato soup
recipes.description: Smoky tomato soup with chickpeas, potato and kale.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika. Add the potato, tomatoes and broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Add the chickpeas and chopped kale and cook for 8 minutes.

recipes.name: Lentil salad with roasted peppers and feta
recipes.description: Brown lentils with roasted peppers, feta and arugula.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the lentils in the water for 25 minutes and drain. Roast the peppers at 220 C for 20 minutes and slice. Toss the lentils with the peppers, onion, parsley, arugula, oil and vinegar, and crumble over the feta.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable quesadillas
recipes.description: Tortillas filled with chicken, peppers, corn and cheddar.
recipes.instructions: Fry the diced chicken with the cumin in the oil for 6 minutes, add the pepper and corn for 3 minutes. Fill the tortillas with the mixture and grated cheddar, fold and toast for 2 minutes per side. Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Mushroom and buckwheat soup
recipes.description: Light Ukrainian soup with mushrooms, buckwheat and potato.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot and sliced mushrooms in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the water, potato and rinsed buckwheat and simmer for 20 minutes. Season and serve with dill.

recipes.name: Salmon rice noodle salad
recipes.description: Rice noodles with seared salmon, edamame and crunchy vegetables.
recipes.instructions: Cook the noodles and rinse cold. Sear the salmon for 4 minutes per side and flake. Boil the edamame for 4 minutes. Toss the noodles with the shredded vegetables, edamame, lime juice, soy sauce and sesame oil, and top with the salmon and coriander.

recipes.name: Black bean soup
recipes.description: Cumin-spiced black bean soup topped with avocado.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and cumin. Add the beans and broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend half, add the lime juice and serve with diced avocado.

recipes.name: Beef and cabbage soup (shchi)
recipes.description: Ukrainian cabbage soup with beef, potato and tomato.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the beef in the broth for 60 minutes. Add the shredded cabbage and diced potato for 15 minutes. Fry the onion and carrot with the tomato paste and add for 10 minutes. Season and serve with dill and sour cream.

recipes.name: Mediterranean chickpea quinoa salad
recipes.description: Quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and olives in lemon dressing.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes and cool. Toss with the chickpeas, diced cucumber, halved tomatoes, onion, olives and parsley. Dress with the oil and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Bulgur pilaf with chickpeas
recipes.description: Tomato bulgur pilaf with chickpeas, carrot and onion.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, stir in the tomato paste and bulgur. Add the broth, cover and simmer for 12 minutes. Fold in the chickpeas, rest for 5 minutes and serve with parsley.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with asparagus and potatoes
recipes.description: Sheet-pan salmon with asparagus, baby potatoes, lemon and dill.
recipes.instructions: Roast the halved potatoes with half the oil at 220 C for 20 minutes. Add the asparagus and salmon, drizzle with the rest of the oil and lemon juice and roast for 12 minutes more. Serve with dill.

recipes.name: Chicken paprikash with egg noodles
recipes.description: Chicken thighs in a paprika and sour cream sauce.
recipes.instructions: Brown the chicken in the oil, add the onion and pepper and cook for 8 minutes. Stir in the paprika, add the broth and simmer covered for 25 minutes. Stir in the sour cream off the heat. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
recipes.description: Sirloin strips and broccoli in a soy-ginger sauce, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Sear the sliced beef in the hot sesame oil for 2 minutes and set aside. Stir-fry the broccoli with the garlic and ginger for 4 minutes, add a splash of water. Return the beef, add the soy sauce and toss. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Pork tenderloin with sweet potatoes and sprouts
recipes.description: Mustard-rosemary pork tenderloin roasted with vegetables.
recipes.instructions: Toss the cubed sweet potato and halved sprouts with the oil and roast at 210 C for 15 minutes. Brush the pork with mustard and rosemary, add to the tray and roast for 20 minutes. Rest for 5 minutes and slice.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp pasta with zucchini
recipes.description: Pasta with shrimp, zucchini, garlic, lemon and parsley.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta. Fry the garlic and chili in the oil for 1 minute, add the diced zucchini for 4 minutes, then the shrimp for 3 minutes. Toss with the pasta, lemon juice, a splash of pasta water and parsley.

recipes.name: Cod in tomato and olive sauce with couscous
recipes.description: Cod fillets simmered in tomato sauce with olives and basil.
recipes.instructions: Fry the garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and olives and simmer for 10 minutes. Lay in the cod, cover and cook for 8 minutes. Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes. Serve the fish over couscous with basil.

recipes.name: Chicken and spinach curry
recipes.description: Chicken in a tomato-yogurt curry with spinach, served with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder. Add the diced chicken and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the spinach, then the yogurt off the heat.

recipes.name: Beef meatballs in tomato sauce with buckwheat
recipes.description: Tender meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, served with buckwheat.
recipes.instructions: Mix the beef with the egg, grated onion, breadcrumbs and seasoning and roll into balls. Brown in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer covered for 20 minutes. Cook the buckwheat in the salted water for 15 minutes and serve together.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta with bulgur and yogurt sauce
recipes.description: Spiced lamb skewers with bulgur and cucumber yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Mix the minced lamb with the grated onion, parsley, cumin and salt and shape onto skewers. Grill for 10 minutes, turning. Simmer the bulgur in the water for 12 minutes. Mix the yogurt with the grated cucumber and garlic and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Trout with buckwheat and green beans
recipes.description: Pan-fried trout with lemon butter, buckwheat and green beans.
recipes.instructions: Cook the buckwheat in the salted water for 15 minutes. Steam the green beans for 6 minutes. Fry the trout in the butter for 3 minutes per side, add the lemon juice and dill. Serve together.

recipes.name: Roast chicken drumsticks with potatoes
recipes.description: Paprika and garlic drumsticks roasted over potatoes and onion.
recipes.instructions: Toss the drumsticks with the paprika, garlic, half the oil and salt. Toss the potato wedges and onion with the rest of the oil and rosemary. Roast everything together at 200 C for 45 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Eggplant parmesan bake
recipes.description: Baked breaded eggplant layered with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
recipes.instructions: Slice the eggplant, dip in beaten egg and breadcrumbs, brush with oil and bake at 220 C for 20 minutes. Layer in a dish with the sauce, mozzarella and parmesan and bake for 25 minutes. Serve with basil.

recipes.name: Spinach and ricotta pasta bake
