recipes.description: Pasta baked with ricotta, spinach, tomato sauce and mozzarella.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the pack says. Wilt the spinach with the garlic and mix with the ricotta. Toss the pasta with the sauce and the ricotta mixture, top with mozzarella and bake at 200 C for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Mushroom stroganoff with rice
recipes.description: Mushrooms and onion in a paprika sour cream sauce, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, add the sliced mushrooms and garlic and cook for 10 minutes. Stir in the paprika and sour cream and warm through without boiling. Serve with the rice and parsley.

recipes.name: Turkey meatloaf with mashed potatoes
recipes.description: Lean turkey meatloaf with carrot and oats, served with mash.
recipes.instructions: Mix the turkey with the egg, oats, grated onion and carrot and seasoning, shape a loaf, brush with tomato paste and bake at 190 C for 50 minutes. Boil the potatoes and mash with the milk and butter.

recipes.name: Fish tacos with tilapia
recipes.description: Chili-lime tilapia in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw and yogurt sauce.
recipes.instructions: Rub the fish with the chili, salt and oil and pan-fry for 3 minutes per side, then flake. Toss the shredded cabbage with half the lime juice. Mix the yogurt with the rest of the lime. Fill the warmed tortillas with fish, slaw, avocado and sauce.

recipes.name: Garlic squid with rice and peppers
recipes.description: Quick-seared squid with garlic, peppers and lemon over rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the sliced pepper in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the squid rings, garlic and paprika and sear over high heat for 2 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and parsley and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Honey garlic chicken thighs with rice
recipes.description: Glazed chicken thighs with broccoli and rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli. Brown the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes per side. Add the garlic, honey and soy sauce and simmer until glazed, about 8 minutes. Serve with the rice and broccoli, sprinkled with sesame.

recipes.name: Beef goulash with potatoes
recipes.description: Hungarian-style beef and paprika stew with potatoes.
recipes.instructions: Fry the onion in the oil for 10 minutes, add the beef and brown. Stir in the paprika, cumin and tomato paste, add the broth and simmer covered for 75 minutes. Add the potatoes and pepper and cook for 25 minutes more.

recipes.name: Lentil mushroom burgers with salad
recipes.description: Vegan lentil and mushroom patties with a tomato salad.
recipes.instructions: Simmer the lentils in the water for 25 minutes and drain. Fry the chopped mushrooms, onion and garlic for 8 minutes. Pulse with the lentils, oats, ground flax and tomato paste, shape 8 patties and fry for 4 minutes per side. Serve with the lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Quinoa and chickpea stuffed zucchini
recipes.description: Zucchini boats filled with quinoa, chickpeas, tomato and pine nuts.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes. Halve the zucchini and scoop out the flesh. Fry the onion, garlic, chopped zucchini flesh and tomato for 8 minutes, mix with the quinoa and chickpeas. Fill the boats, top with pine nuts and bake at 200 C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut haddock curry
recipes.description: Haddock and spinach in a coconut tomato curry, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the ginger and curry powder. Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the fish in chunks and the spinach and cook for 6 minutes.

recipes.name: Pork loin with apples and mashed potatoes
recipes.description: Pan-roasted pork with thyme apples and onion, with mash.
recipes.instructions: Boil the potatoes and mash with the milk and half the butter. Brown the pork in the oil, then roast at 200 C for 20 minutes. Fry the apple wedges and onion in the rest of the butter with thyme for 8 minutes. Slice the pork and serve with the apples and mash.

recipes.name: Pesto salmon with green beans and quinoa
recipes.description: Baked salmon topped with pesto, with quinoa and green beans.
recipes.instructions: Cook the quinoa in the water for 15 minutes. Spread the pesto over the salmon and bake at 200 C for 14 minutes. Steam the green beans for 6 minutes. Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled with beans and sweet potato, baked in chili sauce.
recipes.instructions: Roast the diced sweet potato at 220 C for 20 minutes. Fry the onion in the oil, add the cumin and half the chili, mix with the beans and sweet potato. Mix the tomato puree with the rest of the chili. Roll the filling in the tortillas, cover with the sauce and bake at 190 C for 20 minutes. Serve with avocado and coriander.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu and vegetable stir-fry
recipes.description: Tofu, peppers, broccoli and carrot in a peanut-lime sauce, with rice.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Brown the cubed tofu in the oil and set aside. Stir-fry the vegetables with the garlic and ginger for 5 minutes. Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, lime juice and water, add with the tofu and toss until glossy.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage and white bean casserole
recipes.description: Turkey sausages baked with white beans in a smoky tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions: Brown the sausages in the oil and slice. Fry the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika. Add the tomatoes, beans and sausage and bake covered at 180 C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Seafood linguine
recipes.description: Pasta with shrimp, mussels and squid in a garlic tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta. Fry the garlic and chili in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the mussels, cover and cook until they open, then the shrimp and squid for 3 minutes. Toss with the pasta and parsley.

recipes.name: Sweet potato and red lentil curry
recipes.description: Vegan coconut curry with red lentils, sweet potato and spinach.
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder. Add the lentils, diced sweet potato, tomatoes, coconut milk and water and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in the spinach and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Buckwheat and beef patties (grechanyky) with salad
recipes.description: Ukrainian patties of buckwheat and beef with a cucumber-tomato salad.
recipes.instructions: Mix the beef with the buckwheat, egg, grated onion and seasoning and shape 10 patties. Fry in the oil for 4 minutes per side, then cover and cook for 5 minutes. Serve with a salad of cucumber, tomato and dill, and sour cream.

recipes.name: Beet hummus with rye bread
recipes.description: Bright beetroot hummus with rye bread.
recipes.instructions: Roast the beet wrapped in foil at 200 C for 45 minutes, peel. Blend with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, oil and salt. Serve with rye bread.

recipes.name: Yogurt with raspberries and honey
recipes.description: Plain yogurt with fresh raspberries.
recipes.instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl, top with raspberries and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Spiced roasted pumpkin seeds
recipes.description: Pumpkin seeds roasted with paprika.
recipes.instructions: Toss the seeds with the oil, paprika and salt and roast at 180 C for 8-10 minutes, stirring once. Cool before serving.

recipes.name: Banana peanut butter smoothie
recipes.description: Vegan smoothie of banana, peanut butter, oats and cocoa.
recipes.instructions: Blend everything until smooth and serve cold.

recipes.name: Ricotta cup with blueberries and almonds
recipes.description: Creamy ricotta with blueberries, almonds and honey.
recipes.instructions: Divide the ricotta into cups and top with the blueberries, chopped almonds and honey.

recipes.name: Almonds and dates
recipes.description: Dates stuffed with whole almonds.
recipes.instructions: Pit the dates and stuff each with one or two almonds.

recipes.name: Tuna cucumber bites
recipes.description: Cucumber rounds topped with dill tuna salad.
recipes.instructions: Mix the drained tuna with the yogurt, dill and lemon juice. Slice the cucumber into thick rounds and top each with the tuna salad.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon cucumber rolls
recipes.description: Cucumber ribbons rolled with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
recipes.instructions: Slice the cucumber lengthwise into ribbons. Spread with cream cheese, lay on the salmon and dill and roll up.

recipes.name: Rye crisp with egg and avocado
recipes.description: Rye bread with mashed avocado and boiled egg.
recipes.instructions: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes and slice. Spread the rye with mashed avocado and top with the egg, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Ham and Swiss cheese roll-ups
recipes.description: Ham and cheese rolled around cucumber sticks with mustard.
recipes.instructions: Spread the ham with mustard, lay on a slice of cheese and a cucumber stick and roll up.

recipes.name: Oat peanut energy bites
recipes.description: No-bake vegan bites of oats, dates, peanut butter and cocoa.
recipes.instructions: Blend the dates into a paste, mix with the oats, peanut butter, chia and cocoa and roll into 20 balls. Chill for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate avocado mousse
recipes.description: Vegan chocolate mousse from avocado and cocoa, with raspberries.
recipes.instructions: Blend the avocado, cocoa, maple syrup and almond milk until smooth. Chill and serve with raspberries.

recipes.name: Banana strawberry nice cream
recipes.description: Frozen banana and strawberries blended into soft ice cream.
recipes.instructions: Freeze the sliced banana and strawberries for at least 4 hours. Blend with the almond milk until creamy and serve at once.

recipes.name: Carrot, apple and raisin salad
recipes.description: Grated carrot and apple with raisins and lemon.
recipes.instructions: Grate the carrot and apple, toss with the raisins, lemon juice and oil.

recipes.name: Beet salad with walnuts and garlic
recipes.description: Ukrainian-style boiled beet salad with walnuts, raisins and sour cream.
recipes.instructions: Boil the beets for 45 minutes, cool, peel and grate. Mix with the chopped walnuts, grated garlic, raisins and sour cream.

recipes.name: Buttermilk blueberry smoothie
recipes.description: Tangy smoothie of buttermilk, blueberries and oats.
recipes.instructions: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with pear and cinnamon
recipes.description: Cottage cheese with sliced pear, walnuts and cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: Top the cottage cheese with sliced pear, chopped walnuts and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Swiss cheese with grapes and walnuts
recipes.description: A small cheese plate with grapes and walnuts.
recipes.instructions: Slice the cheese and serve with the grapes and walnuts.

recipes.name: Cashew and seed trail mix
recipes.description: Vegan mix of cashews, pumpkin seeds, cranberries and coconut.
recipes.instructions: Mix everything and store in a jar. One serving is about a small handful.

recipes.name: Banana oat blueberry muffins
recipes.description: Vegan muffins with oats, banana, peanut butter and blueberries.
recipes.instructions: Blend half the oats into flour. Mash the bananas with the peanut butter and almond milk, mix in all the oats, flax and baking powder, then fold in the blueberries. Fill 10 muffin cups and bake at 180 C for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Shrimp cocktail
recipes.description: Poached shrimp with a lemony tomato dip on lettuce.
recipes.instructions: Poach the shrimp in salted water for 2 minutes and chill. Mix the tomato puree with the lemon juice. Serve the shrimp over lettuce with the dip.

recipes.name: Zucchini and feta fritters
recipes.description: Pan-fried zucchini fritters with feta and dill, with yogurt.
recipes.instructions: Grate and squeeze the zucchini. Mix with the eggs, flour, crumbled feta and dill. Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes per side. Serve with the yogurt.

recipes.name: Baked sweet potato fries
recipes.description: Oven-baked sweet potato wedges with paprika.
recipes.instructions: Cut the sweet potato into fries, toss with the oil, paprika and salt and bake at 220 C for 25 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: White bean and rosemary dip with pita
recipes.description: Creamy white bean dip with garlic and rosemary.
recipes.instructions: Blend the beans with the garlic, lemon juice, oil, rosemary and salt until smooth. Serve with warm pita wedges.

recipes.name: Mozzarella and tomato skewers
recipes.description: Caprese skewers with basil and olive oil.
recipes.instructions: Thread the mozzarella cubes, tomatoes and basil leaves onto skewers and drizzle with oil.

recipes.name: Cocoa yogurt with banana
recipes.description: Greek yogurt with cocoa, honey and banana.
recipes.instructions: Stir the cocoa and honey into the yogurt and top with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Orange with dates and pistachios
recipes.description: Orange slices with chopped dates and pistachios.
recipes.instructions: Peel and slice the oranges, scatter with the chopped dates and pistachios.

recipes.name: Chicken and apple salad lettuce cups
recipes.description: Yogurt chicken salad with celery and apple in lettuce leaves.
recipes.instructions: Poach the chicken for 15 minutes, cool and dice. Mix with the yogurt, mustard, diced celery and apple. Spoon into lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Peach almond smoothie
recipes.description: Vegan smoothie of peach, almond milk, oats and almonds.
recipes.instructions: Blend everything until smooth.

recipes.name: Kiwi and strawberry skewers with yogurt
recipes.description: Fruit skewers with a honey yogurt dip.
recipes.instructions: Thread the kiwi and strawberry pieces onto skewers. Mix the yogurt with the honey and serve as a dip.

recipes.name: Baked pears with walnuts
recipes.description: Vegan baked pears with walnuts, maple and cinnamon.
recipes.instructions: Halve and core the pears, fill with chopped walnuts, drizzle with maple syrup and cinnamon and bake at 190 C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Coconut macaroons
recipes.description: Chewy macaroons from coconut, egg white and sugar.
recipes.instructions: Whisk the egg whites with the sugar until foamy, fold in the coconut. Drop 20 mounds onto a lined tray and bake at 170 C for 15 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Pumpkin oat cookies
recipes.description: Vegan soft cookies with pumpkin, oats, walnuts and raisins.
recipes.instructions: Mix the pumpkin puree, maple syrup and ground flax. Stir in the oats, cinnamon, baking powder, chopped walnuts and raisins. Shape 24 cookies and bake at 180 C for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Smoked salmon rye bites
recipes.description: Rye bread squares with cream cheese, smoked salmon and cucumber.
recipes.instructions: Spread the rye bread with cream cheese, cut into squares and top with smoked salmon, sliced cucumber and dill.

recipes.name: Edamame hummus with vegetables
recipes.description: Green hummus of edamame and tahini with carrot and cucumber sticks.
recipes.instructions: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and cool. Blend with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, oil, water and salt. Serve with the vegetables cut into sticks.
